currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Nelson Mandela Bay Stadium: mapped scalloped rounded rectangular flower roof/open central field, curved closed opaque metal petals and alternating closed pale membrane fields/renderable underside/three-chord truss approximations, two-level open colonnade/pale concrete galleries/dark glazed box band/closed recessed services and entries, broad red/warm lower seating tier/two narrower upper bands/aisles/hospitality belts, bounded supported sunken football floor/markings/goals and roof-hung neutral end displays/lights. Five existing shared concrete/paint/standing-seam/window-grid/canvas graphs. No generic smooth roof, field roof, whole lakeside/plaza slab, copied branding/crowd or furnished service interiors.
